item.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
item.description: FairStress is a new benchmark that reveals demographic differences in how LLMs defend and explain their decisions, even when their final choices appear fair.

item.title: A crop-mapping benchmark for the tropics
item.description: PLANTEUR extends the PASTIS crop-mapping benchmark to six tropical regions to help evaluate geospatial models across more diverse agricultural systems.

item.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
item.description: OlmoEarth v1.3 brings state-of-the-art satellite embeddings, precomputed global data, and a browser-based Embeddings Explorer for mapping and analyzing the planet.

item.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
item.description: LitPivot helps researchers refine early research ideas through literature-supported critiques and revisions as their proposals evolve.
